annotations.title: Send as the line (any wired account)

description: Send a message as the line through one of its wired channel accounts (Telegram bot, Gmail …): reply_to answers through the same account and thread, account picks an account, kind uses the default outgoing account of that kind. Only the cable that holds the lease sends; the message is stamped with the cable and epoch and goes to the memory of the line.

account.description: Channel account wired to this line (account_id from line_wiring_list).

kind.description: Channel kind (telegram_bot, gmail …): use the default outgoing account of that kind.

parts.description: Attachments as mot.msg.v1 parts: {type: voice|audio|image|video|file|link, mime, url (https), size, sha256, name?}.

reply_to.description: message_id from line_inbox: the reply goes out through the same account and thread.

thread_key.description: Thread on that channel; defaults to the recipient.

to.description: Recipient on that channel (chat id, e-mail …). With reply_to it defaults to the author.

name: line_send
